Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Windforce 2X MAX OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Elevate your mainstream system performance and high-speed multi-display productivity with the Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Windforce 2X MAX OC 8GB GDDR7 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered on NVIDIA's next-generation architecture, this specialized MAX performance edition introduces a full 8GB profile of next-gen GDDR7 memory layout clocked at an incredible 28 Gbps on a solid 128-bit memory bus structure. Featuring a compact dual-fan layout measuring just 199mm in length, it delivers magnificent case compatibility while optimizing thermal dissipation through Gigabyte's refined Windforce cooling configuration. Outfitted with premium high-definition DisplayPort 2.1b and HDMI 2.1b output configurations, this factory overclocked card supports up to 4 simultaneous displays at crisp digital resolutions. Requiring a single 8-pin power connector, this reliable GPU architecture is officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
